payload.summary: The account msmith on host victim-web-01 experienced a brute force attack from IP 10.77.0.64, which is a known source for the account. The attack involved 10 failed login attempts followed by a successful login, suggesting a potential compromise.

attack_chain.description: An attacker used brute force techniques to guess the password for the account msmith on host victim-web-01 from IP 10.77.0.64.

risk_factors: Brute force attack indicates potential unauthorized access
Successful login after multiple failures suggests compromise

proposed_actions.justification: The account msmith experienced a brute force attack, indicating a potential compromise. Disabling the account will prevent further unauthorized access.
